## Quality & Taxonomy Checklist

Please review and confirm all of the following requirements:

- [ ] **Formatting:** Follows the standard list format: `- [Resource Name](URL) - Concise 1-sentence description ending with a period.`
- [ ] **Alphabetical Order:** Placed in alphabetical order under its corresponding section/sub-category.
- [ ] **Valid Hyperlink:** Verified that the URL is working, non-broken, and leads directly to the primary source (GitHub repo, research paper PDF/arXiv, official standard, or official documentation).
- [ ] **Offensive & Defensive Context:** If adding an offensive technique, tool, or exploit payload, the entry includes corresponding defensive controls, mitigations, or research context.
- [ ] **Vendor Neutrality & Value:** Avoids blatant marketing spam, affiliate links, or unmaintained low-quality repositories.
- [ ] **Grammar & Tone:** Written in objective, technical, professional, and defense-aware language.
